about: Banners the app shows on cheat sheets, and content it treats as retired. Shipped in the guides payload (tools/make_guides.py), so they can change from the server without a release. from = when it starts showing (UTC). untilAsOf = hidden on a guide whose own asOf has reached that patch. Every statement here must be in the official patch notes.

notices.text: Path of Exile 3.30 (Covens of Umbra) reworked the endgame: Scarabs were removed (Threads take their place), the Atlas passive tree was rebuilt and many league mechanics changed. This page was written for 3.29. Updates for 3.30 arrive automatically.

scarabs.text: Scarabs were removed from the game in 3.30. Threads replace them: each Thread adds its league mechanic to a map, and you can spend up to eight on a map.
